did.unittitle: Yale University Press records concerning the publication of individual titles
did.abstract: The records consist of documentation on the publication of works by individual authors. Josef Albers, Hiram Bingham, Harold Bloom, Ernst Cassirer, David Lloyd George, and Paul Rand are just a few of the authors with works documented in this collection. Records consist of correspondence, publication contracts, royalty agreements, promotion and marketing records and financial statements.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The records consist of documentation on the publication of works by individual authors. Josef Albers, Hiram Bingham, Harold Bloom, Ernst Cassirer, David Lloyd George, and Paul Rand are just a few of the authors with works documented in this collection. Records consist of correspondence, publication contracts, royalty agreements, promotion and marketing records and financial statements.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: This finding aid was revised in 2021 to add this processing note to contextualize oppressive and harmful descriptive language used in a folder title in Series Accession 1994-A-132. This folder title contains oppressive and harmful language in its transcribed title of a printed work. The use of this title is not an endorsement of the language it contains. Original descriptive language has been retained to promote searchability and discoverability.

Previous versions of this finding aid may be available. Please contact Manuscripts and Archives for details. If you have questions or comments about these revisions, please contact Manuscripts and Archives. For more information on reparative archival description at Yale, see Yale's Statement on Harmful Language in Archival Description.
